zh: 正式發布智能計算器「定期投入頻率」更新：投資結果預測現在可直接處理每日、每週、每兩週、每月、每季、每半年及每年投入，並按真實投入時點計算複利，不再把非月供條件忽略或誤換算成月供。
「本金9.6萬，每年存入7000，年化8%，11年後多少錢？」可零追問完整識別為本金 96,000、每次投入 7,000、每年 1 次、11 年及年化 8%；累計自行投入本金正確為 173,000。
同一套投入頻率口徑已同步用於投資結果預測、目標反推收益率、目標反推需要多久，以及帶最低起投門檻的派息產品；結果頁及條件核對區會明確顯示「每次投入金額 + 投入頻率」。
保留每日／週／雙週／月／季／半年／年投入、最低起投、所需收益率／年期及 390×844 手機流程的專項回歸；完整 Flutter 測試為 142 項並全部通過，Web Release 構建成功。
v1.18.0 的 GitHub Actions 在 Android universal APK、3 個 ABI APK 及 142 項測試全部成功後，於 Web dart2js 階段收到 GitHub hosted runner 的 shutdown signal（exit -15），因此沒有產生公開 Release 資產。v1.18.1 不改變上述功能邏輯，作為同一功能集的正式重發版本。
en: Formally releases the Smart Calculator recurring-contribution update. Investment Projection now supports daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, quarterly, semiannual and annual contributions at their actual contribution times instead of dropping or converting non-monthly schedules into monthly funding.

Requests such as “start with 96k, add 7k each year, earn 8% annually — how much after 11 years?” now resolve with no follow-up as 96k starting capital, 7k per contribution, one contribution per year, 11 years and 8% return, with total contributed principal correctly equal to 173k.

The same contribution-frequency model is shared by Investment Projection, Required Return, Time to Goal and minimum-purchase income products. Review cards and result sections explicitly show contribution amount plus contribution frequency.

Keeps dedicated regressions for daily/weekly/biweekly/monthly/quarterly/semiannual/annual schedules, minimum-purchase products, required-return/time calculations and the 390×844 mobile flow. The full Flutter suite has 142 passing tests and the Web release build succeeds.

The v1.18.0 GitHub Actions run successfully completed all 142 tests plus the universal and three ABI Android APK builds, but the hosted runner received a shutdown signal during Web dart2js (exit -15), so no public release assets were produced. v1.18.1 keeps the same functional changes and republishes that feature set as the stable release.
